name: Rubixi
title: The pyramid that forgot its own name
tagline: It changed its name and kept the old key under the mat. Strangers still use it.

chapters.heading: A pyramid in March
paragraphs: Rubixi was born on the 14th of March 2016, in block 1,150,481, in the Homestead age.
It promised to pay early players from the coins of later ones, and to keep a fee for its creator.

chapters.heading: 712 visitors
paragraphs: The chain counts 712 transactions against it. Some came to play. Others came for the fee.

chapters.heading: The key under the mat
paragraphs: Before it was Rubixi, it was DynamicPyramid. When the name changed, one function did not.

chapters.heading: Who you gonna call
paragraphs: The ghost buster does not chase the ghost. She changes the lock.
In Solidity 0.2.1 a constructor is the function that shares the contract's name. DynamicPyramid() no longer matched, so it never ran at birth.
It became a door anyone can open. Call it, and you are the creator; the fees are yours. The last call on the 13th of October 2026 was exactly that: DynamicPyramid.
In Solidity 0.8.38 the constructor has its own keyword, so a rename cannot turn it into a public door.
The owner check reverts instead of quietly skipping, and the creator is set once, at birth, and never again.
